post.title: Which Grand Slam is still played on GRASS? 🎾
post.description:
Which Grand Slam is still played on GRASS? Guess first — then drop from Europe at night into south-west London: grass since 1877, 22 men at the first Championships, and courts cut to 8 mm.

What was your first guess? Do share in the comments below.

Sources: wimbledon.com (History), Wikipedia (The Championships, Wimbledon; US Open; Australian Open; Grass court), The Guardian (2012, 2025), Britannica.
